captions.detailed: This 3D model is a C-shaped snap-on pipe clamp designed for mounting. It features a flat rectangular base with a central screw mounting hole that has a countersunk recess for the screw head. The clamp arms curve outward from the base, forming a circular opening with rounded tips at the ends to facilitate snapping onto a pipe.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric, snap-on C-clamp for pipes in OpenSCAD. The design should allow the user to customize the pipe diameter, clamp thickness, clamp height, opening angle, and mounting screw dimensions.
captions.factory: The design starts with a 2D profile extruded using linear_extrude. The 2D shape is constructed by combining a square base and a circle, subtracting a central circle for the pipe, and subtracting a custom polygon to create the opening angle. Two small circles are translated and rotated to round off the tips of the opening. Finally, the 3D difference operator is used to subtract two perpendicular cylinders from the extruded body to form the screw hole and its larger countersunk head recess.
